notes:
The DEBUG helper line now names the helper actually running, not only the file on disk: the resident reports its own version (helper v28), and an older resident is said to be older.

A departure list captured while a search is on screen marks the departing guest's receipt red at once, without retyping the serial. Nothing is redrawn when a capture changes nothing for the cards on screen.

Legacy mode draws the room pills and the leaving-today mark from the rate list's ledger again, as it did before 1.17.42 — nothing is captured in legacy mode, so the lists STATUS reads stay empty there.
